Excellent! I've added the render module:

**`src/render.js`** — `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:
- Returns a plain-text invoice as a multi-line string
- First line: invoice number (e.g., `INV-2026-0043`) or `DRAFT` if not yet issued
- Second line: customer name (looks up via `getCustomer`, falls back to customer ID)
- Line items: `qty × name - €unitPrice each = €lineTotal` (all amounts via `formatEuros`)
- Last line: `Total: €amount` (via `formatEuros`)

**`test/render.test.js`** — 11 tests covering:
- DRAFT vs issued invoice display
- Customer name lookup (and fallback to ID for missing customers)
- Line item formatting with proper euro formatting
- Multiple lines and correct totals
- Different VAT rates
- Thousands separators and decimal formatting
- Data immutability
